source.paper: A generalizable 3D framework and model for self-supervised learning in medical imaging

task_adaptations.reason: The publication did not evaluate this repository's five abdominal CT classes or its fixed patient-level folds.
task_adaptations.head: one independent Linear(feature_recipe_dimension, 5) head per learning-rate and feature-recipe candidate
task_adaptations.selection_policy: rank candidates on development folds only; held-out test is excluded until the configuration and model source are fixed

learning_rate_reconciliation.paper: The Methods section reports the 13 values as the learning rates searched.
learning_rate_reconciliation.official_code: linear3d.py has a different narrower parser-default LR list and applies effective_lr = nominal_lr * (batch_size * world_size) / 256 before constructing each SGD parameter group.
learning_rate_reconciliation.implementation: The profile intentionally prioritizes the paper's 13 values as nominal, rather than silently replacing them with the code defaults, and follows the official code's global-batch scaling. With batch size 32 and world size 1, effective learning rates are one eighth of the printed paper values. The paper values, code-default discrepancy, effective values, and scaling rule are retained in run provenance.

search_space.candidate_construction: Cartesian product of the 13 nominal learning rates and four feature recipes; all heads share frozen encoder passes.
